old_legacy_stage3a.selected_cvi_evaluation: gated on 7 CVIs; NaN for the other 54 of 61 classifier classes
old_legacy_stage3a.direction: CVI_DIRECTION covers 7 CVIs; every other class silently defaults to MINIMIZE
old_legacy_stage3a.consequence: for an unevaluable predicted CVI every candidate tied at -inf and the incumbent remained the first valid candidate, i.e. the top-ranked warmstart

new_stage4.selected_cvi_evaluation: all 61 classifier classes evaluated through their frozen canonical implementation
new_stage4.direction: explicit for every class from the frozen direction registry; no default, no inference
new_stage4.ml2dac_only_values: upstream MetricObjective read from the vendored CVICollection; score_cvi's optimizer-loss convention inverted exactly once to recover the canonical raw value, and the 2147483647 NaN sentinel mapped back to NaN

historical_policy.downstream_stage3_claims: Stage-3 claims that rest on M0-M3 FINAL SELECTED clustering performance are confounded by the legacy scoring defects and must not be used as evidence that a richer CVI inventory harms or fails to help ML2DAC. Upstream classifier analyses that occur before the scoring stage remain valid.

reporting_requirement: every Stage-4 ML2DAC result carries scoring_semantics_id = ml2dac_corrected_cvi_scoring_v1 and must not be presented as a byte-for-byte reproduction of the Stage-3A execution
